g.title: V4System
g.text: AURUMLAB V4 | END-TO-END GOLD FORECASTING — IMPLEMENTED WORKFLOW + EXPLICIT LIMITS

g.title: market_src
g.text: Gold target: GC=F; context: DXY, SI=F, CL=F, S&P 500, VIX, ^TNX, FX

g.title: market_panel
g.text: Date normalization, duplicate/price validation, context joins
Optional context series must not silently become target data

g.title: gdelt
g.text: Timespan supplied by user (default 7d); max 250 results

g.title: norm
g.text: published_at, retrieved_at, title, summary, source, URL

g.title: archive
g.text: Log records attempted windows, NOT completeness

g.title: newsfeat
g.text: English keyword lexicon on title + summary
Daily counts, mean/std score, positive/negative share, source count, observed flag

g.title: cutoff
g.text: Next market-row close target (horizon=1 by default)
News features shifted one market row

g.title: gate
g.text: Query-window span threshold default 0.80 is only a minimum safeguard
Verified archive required for eligible news model; optional exploratory override

g.title: cv
g.text: sklearn TimeSeriesSplit; 5 folds; gap = target horizon
No random shuffle; same dates for feature-set comparisons

g.title: compare
g.text: XGBoost, Random Forest, Extra Trees, HistGradientBoosting

g.title: governance
g.text: Must beat configured baselines + improvement threshold
Exploratory unverified-news candidate cannot be promoted

g.title: api
g.text: Feature schema validation; local /docs; live console + metric table

g.title: aws
g.text: Manual approval → endpoint → monitoring; incurs AWS cost
